prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: thesis-grade concept figure. Generate a clean academic infographic on a white background showing a two-column mapping from four educational problems to four platform solutions. Left column contains four stacked problem cards with strong red-orange accents: 实验环境问题, 学习路径断裂问题, AI实验能力分散问题, 课程共享与更新问题. Right column contains four stacked solution cards with green-blue accents: 环境承载与统一入口, HTML—Blockly—Jupyter学习主线, XEduHub完整工具箱, 教师课程分享与更新机制. Each problem card must connect to its matching solution card with a clear arrow. Overall composition must be balanced, readable, and suitable for a formal thesis or project proposal figure. Use very short Chinese labels only, no extra text, no people, no logos, no watermark, no clutter, no decorative poster style.
